subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Hot-Cold Empathy Gaps
description: A fast breakdown of Hot-Cold Empathy Gaps for builders.

hook.text: When full, you can't imagine being hungry enough to eat three pizzas. After fasting, you order four.

buildup.text: Loewenstein showed we consistently fail to predict how emotions will change our future decisions.

discovery.text: Hot-cold empathy gap: in a calm state, we can't predict what we'll do when aroused, angry, or starving.

twist.text: Dieters plan meals when full and wonder why they break their diet when hungry. The gap is predictable.

climax.text: Design for your hot state while you're cold. Set rules now that your future emotional self must follow.

punchline.text: Plan sober. Your future self won't be.

quiz.question: What does a hot-cold empathy gap cause?
options: We perfectly predict future emotional decisions
We fail to predict how emotions will change our choices
We become more rational under stress
